items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: And this was Claus Ogerman, there we are. And Claus had his hands up in the air and I’m in the booth with my hands up ready to cue the singers

ctx.x: But the wonderful thing was that everybody was such good friends. I mean I remember doing a big thing and we finished a take, I think it was one of the Pepsi things. And it was a big thing. And whoever was in the booth said, “I’ll buy that.” And from the back of the

percussion section George Devin said, “I’m not selling.” And I’ll tell you one of the great things, I mean there was so much friend and camaraderie on it. I was doing a session, I contracted the voices for — oh come on, come on, okay I’ll get it in a minute, but nevertheless the voices were in the booth and in the connecting booth was the artist who was Sammy Davis Junior. And this was Claus Ogerman, there we are. And Claus had his hands up in the air and I’m in the booth with my hands up ready to cue the singers…
That’s terrific. Did you ever work with Joe Wilder?
